question: In which year was the Child Marriage Restraint Act passed in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1929.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Indian Imperial Legislative Council** passed the** Child Marriage Restriction Act, of 1929,** on** September 28.**
 
• It set the legal marriage age for** men and women** at **18 and 14 r**espectively.
 
• It was changed to** 15 for females in 1949, **and then to **18 for girls and 21 for boys in 1978**, following India's independence.
 
• After its sponsor **Harbilas Sharda,** it is commonly referred to as the **Sarda Act.**
 
• On** 1 April 1930, six months **after it went into effect, it extended to all of British India.
 
• It came forth as a result of the **Indian social reform movement.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Prohibition of Child Marriage (Amendment) Bill, 2021:**

 
 
• The **Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006**, is amended by the **bill to raise the legal age of consent** for **female marriage** from **18 to 21.**
 
• According to the 2006 Act, a person who was** married before reaching majority **may request an annulment within two years** (i.e., before 20 years of age).**
 
• This is extended by the Bill to** five years (i.e., 23 years of age).**
